basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a recent addition to the Reddit community, diving headfirst into the colorful world of Royale High Trading. I'm a 31-year-old pharmacy technician from Ohio, with a passion for gaming and trading virtual items. My interests range from strategic games like World of Tanks to the whimsical universe of Royale High. I enjoy learning new things, which led me to explore subreddits related to my profession, such as PharmacyResidency. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, and I'm happily single, focusing on my career and online hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies primarily in pharmacy and gaming. I have a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences and have been working in the field for over a decade. My gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and engaging with communities online, where self-teaching and community feedback have been invaluable.
